question: What has Accenture reported most recently, and what is its outlook for fiscal 2027?
grading: Reference-free (no fixed answer), graded for recency and support. Expect the agent to identify the 2026-10-01 release (fiscal year ended 2026-08-31): Q4 revenue USD 18.68B (+6% USD, +7% local currency) above the guided USD 17.75B-18.40B; FY2026 revenue about USD 74.2B; FY2027 outlook revenue growth 3%-6% in local currency and GAAP diluted EPS USD 14.39-14.81. Snapshot as of 2026-10-03; later runs may have newer developments. Must cite dated sources and not present superseded (June 2026) figures as current.
answer: As of 2026-10-03 the most recent Accenture development is its fourth-quarter and full-year fiscal 2026 results released October 1, 2026 (year ended August 31, 2026): Q4 revenues USD 18.68 billion (+6% in USD, +7% in local currency), above the guided USD 17.75-18.40 billion; Q4 new bookings USD 22.17 billion; full-year revenues USD 74.2 billion (+6% USD, +5% local currency) and GAAP diluted EPS USD 13.56 (adjusted USD 13.97). Fiscal 2027 outlook: revenue growth of 3% to 6% in local currency, operating margin 15.9%-16.1%, GAAP diluted EPS USD 14.39-14.81, free cash flow USD 11.0-11.8 billion and at least USD 9.5 billion of capital return; Q1 FY2027 revenue guided to USD 18.95-19.60 billion. [T15-E1, T15-E2]

output.answer:
## Accenture's Most Recent Report: Q4 & Full-Year FY2026 (reported Oct. 1, 2026)

**Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended Aug. 31, 2026):**
- **Revenue:** $18.7B, up 6% in USD and 7% in local currency — ahead of the ~$18.0B consensus
- **GAAP EPS:** $3.29, up 46% YoY; adjusted EPS up 9%, beating the ~$3.18–3.19 estimate
- **New bookings:** $22.2B, up 4% USD / 5% local currency, book-to-bill of 1.2 — a return to bookings growth after a 3% local-currency decline in Q3
- **Segment/region detail:** Managed Services revenue $9.4B (+7%); Consulting $9.28B (+6%). Americas $9.4B (+7%), EMEA $6.6B (+6%), Asia Pacific $2.7B (+3%)
- **Cash:** ~$2.8–2.9B free cash flow in the quarter (sources differ slightly)

**Full-Year FY2026:**
- Revenue **$74.2B**, up 6%
- **Adjusted EPS $13.97**, up 8%
- **Bookings $84.5B**; **$11.5B returned to shareholders** (including ~$2B of additional Q4 buybacks)

The quarter was well received — the stock jumped roughly 20% on the news, its best single-day move, as results eased investor worries about AI disruption to traditional consulting.

## Fiscal 2027 Outlook

Accenture's initial FY2027 guidance:

| Metric | Guidance |
|---|---|
| Revenue growth (local currency) | **3%–6%** |
| — of which acquisitions | ~2%–2.5% (implies organic growth of roughly 0.5%–4%, midpoint ~2%) |
| GAAP diluted EPS | **$14.39–$14.81** (6%–9% YoY increase) |
| Operating margin | **15.9%–16.1%** |
| Q1 FY2027 revenue | **$18.95B–$19.60B**, 2%–6% local-currency growth |
| Incremental M&A | ~$5B planned |

**Management commentary:** CEO Julie Sweet said Q4 grew 7% in local currency across every geographic market and both business lines, tied to large-scale reinventions and data/AI work. The company expects AI demand to broaden into FY2027, though management framed the year around balanced growth amid pricing pressure and cautious discretionary spending. Hiring will continue in every market but at a slower pace than FY2026. The CFO noted roughly $3B tied to Cyber/OT acquisitions shifted into Q1 FY2027 due to regulatory timing.

**Caveat:** Not all analysts are convinced — Morgan Stanley flagged that declining bookings (in prior quarters) cloud visibility into FY2027, and several noted the guidance midpoint implies only modest organic growth, with growth weighted toward the second half.

**Sources:**
- https://news.alphastreet.com/acn-earnings-key-quarterly-highlights-from-accentures-q4-2026-financial-results
- https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/accenture-shares-soar-fourth-quarter-151100410.html
- https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/accenture-jumps-20-ibm-climbs-154957520.html
- https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/news/accenture-q4-earnings-call-sees-130000263.html
- https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/accenture-stock-pulls-back-investors-180020984.html

*Note: figures are drawn from secondary news coverage of the Oct. 1, 2026 release; for authoritative numbers, consult Accenture's official press release and 10-K/10-Q filings.*
